biggest_catch: Official pay ($8/hr minimum, $12/hr recommended) and official payout timing are confirmed, but each study shows its own reward and you only get studies matching your demographics - volume is unpredictable.
catches: Study availability depends on your demographics and profile - many users get few studies at first.
Your first 4 cashouts are processed manually (not instant); instant PayPal transfers start after that.
Researchers must approve your submission before earnings land in your balance - approval takes days.
US residents must link a US-based PayPal account; one PayPal per Prolific account.
Rushed or low-quality submissions can be rejected, hurting the approval rate that unlocks more studies.

steps: Register as a participant at prolific.com and verify your account.
Complete your full profile so eligibility filters match you to studies.
Browse the Studies page or Prolific Assistant for studies matching your profile.
Complete studies; researchers approve submissions, then cash out to PayPal once your balance hits $6/£6.
timing: Official: cash out at $6/£6; after your first 4 cashouts, payments are instantly transferred to PayPal.
who_pays: Researchers pay for each study. Prolific enforces a minimum reward of $8 per hour (recommends $12 per hour); once a researcher approves your submission, the earnings land in your Prolific balance.
who_qualifies: Register as a participant, complete account verification and your full profile, and link a PayPal account under the same name (a US-based PayPal for US residents).
work_available: Studies post and fill fast, and eligibility filters match studies to your profile and demographics - many users get few studies at first, so volume is unpredictable.
what_gets_accepted: Only researcher-approved submissions count. Approval takes days, and rushed or low-quality submissions can be rejected, which hurts the approval rate that unlocks more studies.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No upfront fee. Unpaid time includes screening, completing your profile, and waiting days for researcher approval. You can only cash out once your balance hits $6, so small balances sit until they accumulate.
when_cash_arrives: Cash out at $6/GBP6 or more. Your first 4 cashouts are processed manually (slower); after that, payments transfer instantly to your PayPal.
